answer.en: Water. Plain, fresh water is the best drink for adult cats, and your cat should have it available at all times and be able to drink as much as it wants. Cats don't need anything else to drink.
answer.sl: Vodo. Navadna sveža voda je najboljša pijača za odrasle mačke; mačka naj jo ima na voljo ves čas in naj je lahko popije, kolikor želi. Drugih pijač mačke ne potrebujejo.
answer.es: Agua. El agua natural y fresca es la mejor bebida para los gatos adultos, y tu gato debe tenerla disponible en todo momento y poder beber tanta como quiera. Los gatos no necesitan ninguna otra bebida.

why.en: Water helps keep a cat's kidneys working and its organs in good order, and helping cats avoid becoming dehydrated is a very important part of keeping them healthy. Cats Protection and PDSA both say water is the only drink a cat needs.
why.sl: Voda pomaga ohranjati delovanje mačjih ledvic in dobro stanje organov, preprečevanje dehidracije pa je zelo pomemben del skrbi za mačje zdravje. Cats Protection in PDSA navajata, da je voda edina pijača, ki jo mačka potrebuje.
why.es: El agua ayuda a que los riñones del gato funcionen y a que sus órganos estén en buen estado, y ayudar a los gatos a evitar la deshidratación es una parte muy importante de mantenerlos sanos. Cats Protection y PDSA dicen que el agua es la única bebida que necesita un gato.

what_to_do.en: If you are worried your cat is dehydrated, for example it seems lethargic or weak, has a poor appetite or dry gums, contact a vet promptly.
what_to_do.sl: Če vas skrbi, da je mačka dehidrirana, na primer je zaspana ali šibka, slabo je ali ima suhe dlesni, se nemudoma obrnite na veterinarja.
what_to_do.es: Si te preocupa que tu gato esté deshidratado, por ejemplo porque parece apático o débil, tiene poco apetito o las encías secas, ponte en contacto con un veterinario sin demora.

serving.en: Keep fresh water where your cat can easily reach it and replace it at least once a day. Several bowls around the home, cleaned regularly and placed away from the food bowl, help, and some cats drink more from a water fountain.
serving.sl: Svežo vodo imejte tam, kjer jo mačka zlahka doseže, in jo zamenjajte vsaj enkrat na dan. Pomaga več posod po stanovanju, ki jih redno čistite in postavite stran od posode s hrano; nekatere mačke več pijejo iz fontane za vodo.
serving.es: Mantén agua fresca donde tu gato pueda alcanzarla fácilmente y cámbiala al menos una vez al día. Ayuda tener varios cuencos por la casa, limpiados con regularidad y colocados lejos del cuenco de la comida, y algunos gatos beben más en una fuente de agua.

child.en: Fresh water is the best drink for a cat! You can help by checking that kitty's water bowl is clean and full.
child.sl: Sveža voda je za muco najboljša pijača! Pomagaš lahko tako, da preveriš, ali je njena posodica za vodo čista in polna.
child.es: ¡El agua fresca es la mejor bebida para un gato! Puedes ayudar comprobando que el cuenco de agua del gatito esté limpio y lleno.

q.en: How can I help my cat drink more?
q.sl: Kako lahko mački pomagam, da pije več?
q.es: ¿Cómo puedo ayudar a mi gato a beber más?

a.en: Put several clean water bowls around the home, away from the food bowl. Some cats drink more from a fountain, and wet food or water added to food also increases how much water they take in.
a.sl: Po stanovanju postavite več čistih posod z vodo, stran od posode s hrano. Nekatere mačke več pijejo iz fontane, več vode pa zaužijejo tudi z mokro hrano ali z vodo, dodano hrani.
a.es: Pon varios cuencos de agua limpios por la casa, lejos del cuenco de la comida. Algunos gatos beben más en una fuente, y la comida húmeda o el agua añadida a la comida también aumentan la cantidad de agua que toman.

q.en: Do cats need milk as well?

a.en: No. Cats Protection says the best thing for adult cats to drink is water and that they don't need anything else to stay healthy.
a.sl: Ne. Cats Protection navaja, da je za odrasle mačke najboljša pijača voda in da za zdravje ne potrebujejo ničesar drugega.
a.es: No. Cats Protection dice que lo mejor que pueden beber los gatos adultos es agua y que no necesitan nada más para mantenerse sanos.

sources.quote: The best thing for adult cats to drink is water.
Water is essential for helping to maintain kidney function and keep their organs in good working order.
They don’t need anything else to drink to keep them healthy.
Make sure your cat has access to plain, fresh water at all times.
They should be able to drink as much as they want.
Your cat only needs to drink water.
If you don’t think your cat is drinking enough, try putting several water bowls scattered around the house
and refresh and clean them regularly.
Remember many cats don’t like their food and water bowls to be in the same place.
Make sure they always have access to a bowl of water, and replace the water at least once a day to keep it fresh
Clearly, helping cats avoid becoming dehydrated is a very important aspect of their health maintenance
always having fresh water available in places that they can easily access
Some cats increase their intake of water when provided with water fountains
Feeding wet food and/or adding water to food is another good way to increase water intake
Signs of dehydration include lethargy, weakness, poor appetite, dry mucous membranes
If you are concerned that your cat is dehydrated, you should contact a veterinarian promptly.
